龟蛇二怪
陈明钧/绘  余雷/文

清华大学出版社

Turtle and Snake: Two Monsters
Chen Mingjun / Illustrations  Yu Lei / Text

Tsinghua University Press
Beijing
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《龟蛇二怪》的封面，展示了书名、作者、绘者及出版社信息，画面中有一位身着古装、手持长剑、立于浪涛之上的仙人形象。

page_text_ocr_zh:
武当山下有一户人家，庭院幽静，花木繁茂。两个女儿金菊和妮妮经常到花园里赏花游玩。
这一天，她们正在池塘边观赏荷花，突然空中一声巨响，一阵大风袭来，晴朗的天空立刻变得昏暗了。
page_text_en:
Below Wudang Mountain, there was a household with a quiet courtyard and lush flowers and trees. The two daughters, Jinju and Nini, often went to the garden to admire the flowers and play.
One day, while they were admiring the lotus flowers by the pond, suddenly a loud boom came from the sky, followed by a strong wind. The clear sky instantly turned dark.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了武当山下一家人的庭院景象，两个女儿金菊和妮妮正在池塘边赏花，突然天空响起巨响，狂风袭来，天空瞬间变暗。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这阵风来得快，去得也快。转眼间花园里又恢复了宁静，似乎什么也没有发生过，但金菊和婉娘却不见了。
丫环们立刻报告了老爷，老爷马上带人把花园搜了个底朝天，找遍了花园的每个角落，但都没有发现姐妹俩的踪影。
page_text_en:
The wind came quickly and left just as fast. In an instant, the garden returned to peace, as if nothing had happened, but Jinju and Wan Niang were gone.
The maids immediately reported to the master, who quickly led people to search the garden thoroughly, checking every corner, but they found no trace of the two sisters.
summary_zh: 狂风过后，花园恢复平静，但金菊和婉娘却不见了踪影。丫环们报告老爷后，众人在花园中四处搜寻，却一无所获。

page_text_ocr_zh:
老爷只好燃起三炷香请来城隍，城隍问了当地的土地，这才
知道刚才那阵妖风是武当山的龟蛇二怪刮的，姐妹俩很有可能被
他们抢走了。
老爷急忙恳求城隍搭救金菊和婉娘，城隍爽快地答应了。他
带着全副武装的神兵来到武当山，围住了龟蛇二怪的水火洞。
page_text_en:
The老爷 had no choice but to light three incense sticks to summon the City God. The City God asked the local Earth God and only then learned that the earlier demonic wind was caused by the turtle and snake demons of Wudang Mountain, and that the two sisters were very likely taken by them.
The老爷 urgently pleaded with the City God to rescue Jinju and Wan Niang. The City God readily agreed. He brought fully armed divine soldiers to Wudang Mountain and surrounded the water and fire cave of the turtle and snake demons.
summary_zh: 老爷请来城隍，得知女儿们被武当山的龟蛇二怪掳走，城隍答应救援，并率神兵包围了龟蛇二怪的水火洞。

page_text_ocr_zh:
龟蛇二怪抓到两个姑娘后很高兴，正在喝酒庆贺。听说有人来攻，立刻派小妖把金菊和婉娘带到后洞看守，准备迎战。
龟蛇二怪冲出洞外，看到城隍带着大队人马围住他们，开口就骂：“大胆狂徒，是谁扫了爷喝酒的兴致？”
page_text_en:
The Turtle and Snake Demons, after capturing the two girls, were very happy and were drinking to celebrate. Hearing that someone was attacking, they immediately sent their minions to take Jinju and Wan Niang to the back cave for guarding, preparing to fight.
The Turtle and Snake Demons rushed out of the cave and saw the City God leading a large army surrounding them. They immediately shouted, "You bold rascals, who dared to ruin my drinking pleasure?"
summary_zh: 龟蛇二怪在洞中庆祝掳走金菊和婉娘，得知城隍率兵围攻后，派小妖看守姑娘并冲出洞外怒骂来犯者。

page_text_ocr_zh:
城隍大喝一声：“放肆！快把金菊和婉娘交出来！”
龟蛇二怪二话不说，举着长枪就冲了上去。城隍沉着迎战，
双方你来我往，大战了几百个回合。
城隍带着神兵步步紧逼，龟蛇二怪渐渐有些招架不住了。就
在城隍要抓住他们时，龟蛇二怪突然变成一座大山挡在了神兵
面前。
page_text_en:
The City God roared, "Impudence! Hand over Jinju and Wan Niang at once!"
The Turtle and Snake Demons, without a word, charged forward with their spears. The City God calmly met them in battle,
and the two sides fought fiercely, exchanging hundreds of blows.
As the City God and his divine soldiers pressed forward, the Turtle and Snake Demons began to struggle. Just
as the City God was about to capture them, the Turtle and Snake Demons suddenly transformed into a huge mountain, blocking the divine soldiers' path.
summary_zh: 城隍率神兵与龟蛇二怪激战，双方大战数百回合，正当城隍即将取胜时，龟蛇二怪化作大山阻挡神兵。

page_text_ocr_zh:
神兵们一时不知所措。趁此机会，龟蛇二怪带着妖兵顺势攻了过来。妖兵们大声呼喊着冲向神兵，神兵们一下乱了阵脚。
城隍急忙让神兵顶住，但妖兵越战越勇，心慌意乱的神兵无心恋战，一路败退。
page_text_en:
The divine soldiers were momentarily at a loss. Seizing the opportunity, the Turtle and Snake Demons led their demon troops to launch a counterattack. The demon soldiers shouted loudly as they charged at the divine soldiers, causing the latter to lose their formation.
The City God hurriedly ordered the divine soldiers to hold their ground, but the demon troops grew bolder with each passing moment, while the anxious and disoriented divine soldiers had no heart for battle and retreated in defeat.
summary_zh: 龟蛇二怪趁神兵混乱之际率妖兵反攻，神兵阵脚大乱，城隍虽下令抵抗，但神兵心慌意乱，最终一路败退。

page_text_ocr_zh:
城隍只能无奈地和神兵们一起撤离。正在他无计可施的时候，只见天上飘来一朵祥云，原来是道行高深的荡魔天尊来了。城隍立刻跪拜，求天尊帮忙。
荡魔天尊原来在蓬莱修行，得道后被玉帝封为天尊，并赐给他七星宝剑护身。听城隍说完来龙去脉，他当即仗剑直奔武当山。
page_text_en:
The City God could only helplessly retreat with his soldiers. Just as he was at a loss, a auspicious cloud floated down from the sky—none other than the highly enlightened Lord of Suppressing Demons had arrived. The City God immediately knelt and begged for his help.
Lord of Suppressing Demons had once practiced in Penglai, and after attaining enlightenment, he was bestowed the title of Heavenly Lord by the Jade Emperor and granted the Seven-Star Sword for protection. After hearing the City God’s account of the situation, he immediately drew his sword and rushed toward Wudang Mountain.
summary_zh: 城隍在与龟蛇二怪激战失败后被迫撤退，危急时刻，道行高深的荡魔天尊驾云降临，城隍跪拜求援，天尊听闻详情后立即持剑前往武当山救援。

page_text_ocr_zh: 荡魔天尊来到水火洞前时，龟蛇二怪正在和妖兵们一起欢庆胜利。龟蛇二怪明知不是天尊的对手，但还是硬着头皮准备迎战。荡魔天尊用手里的七星宝剑一指，一团熊熊燃烧的火球立刻从空中翻滚着落在了龟蛇二怪的身上，烧得他们哇哇大叫。
page_text_en: When the Demonic-Slaying Celestial Master arrived at the entrance of the Water and Fire Cave, the Turtle and Snake Demons were celebrating their victory with their demon soldiers. Although the Turtle and Snake Demons knew they were no match for the Celestial Master, they still braced themselves for battle. The Celestial Master pointed his Seven-Star Saber, and a blazing fireball immediately rolled down from the sky, landing on the Turtle and Snake Demons and burning them until they screamed in agony.
summary_zh: 荡魔天尊抵达水火洞前，龟蛇二怪正与妖兵庆祝胜利，但明知不敌仍准备迎战。天尊以七星宝剑召唤火球，击中二怪，使其痛苦大叫。

page_text_ocr_zh:
妖兵们见此情景都四散逃命，龟蛇二怪被火烧得往山下跑，看到有水的地方就一头扎了进去。
荡魔天尊继续挥舞手中的宝剑，他的宝剑所指之处，一条巨大的瀑布奔流下来，直冲龟蛇二怪。龟蛇二怪只得从水里化成一股烟，逃之夭夭。
page_text_en:
The demons, seeing this scene, scattered and fled. The Turtle and Snake Demons, burned by fire, ran down the mountain and plunged into the first body of water they saw.
Dangmo Tianzun continued to wield his sacred sword. Wherever his sword pointed, a massive waterfall rushed down, directly striking the Turtle and Snake Demons. The demons could only transform into a wisp of smoke and flee.
summary_zh: 荡魔天尊用宝剑召唤瀑布攻击龟蛇二怪，妖兵四散逃命，二怪被逼入水中化作烟雾逃走。

page_text_ocr_zh:
荡魔天尊并没有追赶他们，他收起宝剑走进山洞，只见洞里的小妖都已经逃走了，他走到后洞，找到了金菊和婉娘。
荡魔天尊念起咒语，空中降下两朵祥云载着金菊和婉娘向家的方向飘去。家人看到他们回来，连忙对着空中叩头拜谢。
page_text_en:
Dangmo Tianzun did not pursue them. He sheathed his sword and entered the cave, where he saw that all the little demons had already fled. He walked to the back cave and found Jinju and Wan Niang.
Dangmo Tianzun chanted a spell, and two auspicious clouds descended from the sky, carrying Jinju and Wan Niang back toward their home. The family, seeing them return, hurriedly bowed and thanked the heavens.
summary_zh: 荡魔天尊进入山洞救出被掳走的金菊和婉娘，用祥云将她们送回家，家人在家中叩拜感谢。

page_text_ocr_zh:
荡魔天尊驾着祥云离开武当山，继续寻找龟蛇二怪。经过三里淡的时候，天尊看到淡上黑气笼罩，不禁心想：这里必定会有妖怪。
荡魔天尊变成道士模样降落到淡边。四周静悄悄的，一个人也没有，只有一条小船停在岸边。
page_text_en:
The Demonic-Slaying Heavenly Master rode on a cloud of auspiciousness, leaving Wudang Mountain to continue searching for the turtle and snake demons. When he passed by Sanli Lake, he saw dark mist hovering over the lake and thought to himself: There must be demons here.
The Demonic-Slaying Heavenly Master transformed into the appearance of a Taoist priest and descended to the lakeshore. It was quiet all around; there was no one in sight, only a small boat moored by the shore.
summary_zh: 荡魔天尊驾云离开武当山，继续寻找龟蛇二怪，在三里淡发现黑气笼罩，便化作道士模样降落岸边，只见四周寂静，仅有一条小船停泊。

page_text_ocr_zh:
船上没有船夫，周围也找不到其他人。天尊只好跳上船，自己撑着船篙向溪水中划去。
天尊划着小船来到溪流中央，这里水流很急，一个漩涡连着另一个漩涡。小船突然失去了控制，哪里的水流急，它就漂向哪里。
page_text_en:
There was no boatman on the boat, and no one else could be found around. The Heavenly Master had no choice but to jump onto the boat and row himself into the stream with a pole.
The Heavenly Master rowed the small boat to the center of the stream, where the current was very swift, with one whirlpool following another. Suddenly, the boat lost control and drifted wherever the current was strongest.
summary_zh: 荡魔天尊在三里淡发现黑气后化作道士，乘小船进入溪流，但因水流湍急、漩涡密布，小船失去控制，随波漂流。

page_text_ocr_zh:
突然，天尊手里的船篙飞了出去，一个巨浪猛地打翻了小船。
天尊掉进了湍急的水流中。
天尊这才发现，那条小船是龟怪变的，船篙则是蛇怪变的。
两个妖怪看到天尊落到了水里，高兴得拍手大笑。
page_text_en:
Suddenly, the oar in the Heavenly Master's hand flew out, and a huge wave violently capsized the small boat.
The Heavenly Master fell into the rushing current.
Only then did the Heavenly Master realize that the small boat had been transformed by the turtle demon, and the oar had been transformed by the snake demon.
The two demons, seeing the Heavenly Master fall into the water, laughed with delight, clapping their hands.
summary_zh: 荡魔天尊乘小船进入溪流时，船篙突然飞出，巨浪打翻小船，天尊落水。他发现小船和船篙分别是龟怪和蛇怪所化，两个妖怪见状高兴地拍手大笑。

page_text_ocr_zh:
天尊虽然掉进了水里，但他丝毫不惊慌。他手握七星宝剑念动口诀，身体很快长高，成了一个脚踏水底、头顶云端的巨人。
龟蛇二怪吓得目瞪口呆，忘了逃跑。天尊俯下身子，轻松地把他们抓在手里，任凭两个妖怪怎么挣扎都无法逃脱天尊的巨手。
page_text_en:
Although the Heavenly Master fell into the water, he was not at all panicked. He held the Seven-Star Sword and chanted incantations, causing his body to grow rapidly into a giant who stood with feet on the riverbed and head reaching the clouds.
The turtle and snake demons were terrified, staring in shock and forgetting to flee. The Heavenly Master bent down and easily grabbed them in his hands; no matter how the two demons struggled, they could not escape from his giant grasp.
summary_zh: 荡魔天尊落水后不慌不忙，念动口诀变身为巨人，轻松抓住了惊慌失措的龟蛇二怪。

page_text_ocr_zh:
荡魔天尊往前跨出一步上了岸。他念动口诀把自己的身体变回原来的大小，抽出宝剑对着龟蛇二怪吼道：“你们知错吗？”
龟蛇二怪自知不是天尊的对手，连连告饶，愿意跟随天尊。
于是，天尊收服了他们，两个妖怪后来成了荡魔天尊手下的水火二将。
page_text_en:
Dangmo Tianzun stepped forward and landed on the shore. He chanted a spell, returned his body to its original size, drew his magic sword, and roared at the turtle and snake demons: "Do you know you were wrong?"

The turtle and snake demons, knowing they were no match for Tianzun, begged for mercy and offered to follow him.

Thus, Tianzun tamed them, and the two demons later became the Water and Fire Generals under Dangmo Tianzun's command.
summary_zh: 荡魔天尊变回原形后，用宝剑震慑龟蛇二怪，二怪认错并归顺，最终被收服为水火二将。
